title: Phantasy Star Online Episode III: C.A.R.D. Revolution

info.about: Phantasy Star Online Episode III: C.A.R.D. Revolution is a turn-based role-playing video game released for the GameCube in 2003.
info.trivia: Online play needed a modem or broadband adapter and a 30-day Hunter's License shared with Episodes I and II, until Sega shut the servers on April 1, 2007.
info.why: It was released only on GameCube, so the 2004 disc is the one way to own Sega's card-battle Phantasy Star Online.
